objective: A fictional ceramics-studio website example that follows the 1.3 design flow and passes its checks.

intake.request: Update the website example (bin/cli.js website prompt) with the exact updated skills.

state.milestone: Example approved and delivered at d3

facts.claim: Hollow is fictional and must be disclosed in the first view and footer.
Wheel pottery proceeds through shaping, trimming and firing with glaze.
The example must work from a local file with no external requests.
Bricolage Grotesque is licensed under the SIL OFL.

gaps.question: Real class schedule and prices
gaps.impact: Conversion would become booking; stays fictional.

premise.statement: A pot is a profile turned around a hollow: the one focal object shows profile and form together, and the main interaction is the making (shape, trim, fire).
premise.swap_test: A yoga studio has no profile, foot or kiln stage to show.
invalidated_by: Readers believe the studio is real
premise.answer: No real classes exist (F1); understanding the process is the honest action.

stack.alternative: Astro with the same CSS if the studio became real

rules.relationship: One focal composition per view; treatments limited to named roles.
rules.rule: Noise budget in design.md: 8 font sizes, 3 text colors, 1 radius, 1 shadow, 12 spacing values, 1 focal point.

rules.relationship: Irregular open counters echo the uneven rim; irregularity stays in the illustration.
rules.rule: Hollow (Bricolage Grotesque) is the only family; no handwriting faces; controls stay regular.

rules.relationship: The visitor must know the studio is invented.
rules.rule: Disclosure visible in the first view at every width and in the footer.

check.how: Open desktop, phone and 320px first-view captures

evidence: Opened desktop, phone and 320px first-view captures of index.html d3: the fictional-studio disclosure is visible at every width and in the footer.

evidence: Opened desktop, phone and 320px first-view and full captures plus reduced motion; fixed specimen label grouping and stage-button spacing.
